cna.headline: 'Ongoing dialogue' with China after Mbappe row: Liga chief Tebas
cna.teaser: Kylian Mbappe, Real Madrid and La Liga apologised for the comment after a backlash in China, where mocking former leader Mao Zedong is taboo.
fullText: BARCELONA: La Liga president Javier Tebas said on Monday (Nov 2) he is maintaining dialogue with Chinese authorities in an effort to defuse a row over Kylian Mbappe's comments about former Chinese leader Mao Zedong .
Chinese state broadcaster CCTV did not air a single La Liga match this weekend, while Real Madrid's win at Racing Santander on Sunday was also not shown on pay television in the country.

In a clip from an interview with French show The Bridge which has since been taken down, Mbappe had said he was amused by an internet meme showing his face photoshopped onto "some guy, think he's a Chinese dictator", an apparent reference to Mao.
Mbappe, Real Madrid and La Liga apologised for the comment after a backlash in China, where mocking former leader Mao - blamed by historians for millions of deaths - is taboo.
"There will be ongoing dialogue - I'm speaking with the Chinese authorities, both in Madrid and in Beijing, and we're going to wait."
Tebas, who held a meeting with Chinese ambassador to Spain Yao Jing last week, highlighted several strong links between China and Spanish football which could help resolve the dispute.
"We've had a strategy for several years now with the political and sporting authorities in China," he explained.
Tebas met Chinese State Councillor Shen Yiqin and a high-ranking delegation at Barcelona's La Masia youth academy facilities in February, along with Barcelona president Joan Laporta.
"With the president of China Media Group (the parent organisation of CCTV) we have a good agreement," continued Tebas.
"He's been to La Liga, I've met with him (Shen Haixiong). Every time I travel to Beijing I have a meeting with him."

China effectively cut ties with the NBA for several years from 2019 after then-Houston Rockets general manager Daryl Morey tweeted his support for Hong Kong protesters, but Tebas said he was "hopeful" of reverting the current situation.
"I'm going to travel, talk, and keep talking with the Chinese authorities," he added.
"We'll try everything possible to normalise the situation as much as we can."
Mbappe scored on Sunday as Real Madrid beat Racing 3-0 in La Liga to move within three points of leaders Barcelona.

economistArticle.title: The Demands of Intensive Parenting Reach the Masses
paras: For decades, intensive parenting—a childrearing style characterized by rigorous scheduling, extracurricular enrichment, and constant cognitive stimulation—was largely the preserve of the affluent upper-middle class. High-earning parents possessed both the disposable income to fund music tuition and the flexible schedules required to ferry children between activities. Today, however, sociological research suggests this demanding ethos has trickled down across income brackets. Parents from modest backgrounds now spend a larger share of their earnings and free time striving to cultivate their children's talents.

Driven by heightened anxiety about social mobility, lower-income households are sacrificing personal leisure to emulate high-resource childrearing techniques. In urban hubs from London to Singapore, parents working hourly shifts prioritize educational applications, supplementary tuition, and athletic programs. The pervasive narrative that early childhood decisions dictate lifelong financial security has rendered hyper-vigilance the standard benchmark for responsible parenting nationwide.

Yet, despite this widespread adoption of intensive parenting ideals, the structural playfield remains undeniably uneven. Wealthy families possess far greater financial cushions to absorb economic setbacks, as well as social networks that open doors to elite internships and prestigious mentorships. While a middle-class family might stretch their budget to pay for a single coding workshop, wealthy households seamlessly combine private coaching with bespoke overseas educational travel.

Moreover, the relentless pressure of intensive parenting extracts a disproportionate toll on lower-income caregivers. Wealthier households routinely outsource domestic chores to domestic workers or commercial services, freeing up high-quality energy for child engagement. Conversely, working-class parents face severe cognitive fatigue when trying to balance demanding shift work with the exhausting expectations of hyper-involved parenting.

Ultimately, while the desire to cultivate successful children has become nearly universal, economic inequality continues to dictate the return on that emotional investment. Narrowing the mobility gap will require structural policy interventions in public education and childcare support, rather than relying solely on parental effort.
economistArticle.cn:
几十年来，强化育儿——一种以严苛的时间安排、课外兴趣培养和持续的认知刺激为特征的抚养方式——在很大程度上是富裕的中产阶级上层的专属。高收入父母既有支配收入来资助音乐课，也有灵活的时间安排来接送孩子参加各项活动。然而，如今的社会学研究表明，这种苛刻的育儿理念已逐渐渗透到各个收入阶层。来自普通家庭背景的父母现在也花费更大比例的收入和空闲时间，努力培养孩子的才能。
在对社会流动性日益加剧的焦虑驱使下，低收入家庭正在牺牲个人休闲时间，以效仿资源丰富的育儿技巧。从伦敦到新加坡的各大都市，打零工或按小时计薪的父母优先考虑教育软件、额外补习和体育项目。早期儿童教育决定终身经济安全这一普遍流传的说法，已使“高度警惕”成为全国衡量负责任育儿的标准基准。
然而，尽管密集型育儿理念已被广泛采纳，但结构性的竞争场地依然不可避免地存在不公。富裕家庭拥有厚得多的经济缓冲来抵御经济挫折，并拥有能够通往精英实习和知名导师资源的社交网络。当一个中产阶级家庭咬牙预算支付一个编程工作坊时，富裕家庭却能无缝整合私人辅导与定制的海外游学体验。
此外，密集型育儿带来的无休止压力对低收入照顾者造成了不成比例的沉重负担。富裕家庭通常将家务外包给家政人员或商业服务，从而腾出高质量的精力投入亲子互动。相反，工薪阶层父母在平衡高强度的轮班工作与过度介入式育儿的疲惫期望时，面临着严重的认知疲劳。
归根结底，尽管培养成功下一代的愿望已几乎成为全民共识，但经济不平等仍在决定着这种情感投资的回报率。缩小阶层流动差距需要公共教育和托育支持方面的结构性政策干预，而不仅仅依靠父母个人的努力。

gems.s: Driven by heightened anxiety about social mobility, lower-income households are sacrificing personal leisure to emulate high-resource childrearing techniques.
gems.why: This sentence uses a participial phrase fronting structure ('Driven by...') to establish cause before effect, creating a persuasive analytical tone. 这句话通过分词短语前置结构开篇，先声夺人地阐明因果关系，突出了分析的严密性与说服力。

gems.s: Ultimately, while the desire to cultivate successful children has become nearly universal, economic inequality continues to dictate the return on that emotional investment.
gems.why: This sentence expertly uses a concessive clause ('while...') to acknowledge a shared truth before emphasizing the contrasting economic reality. 句中巧妙使用让步状语从句，在承认社会共识的前提下凸显经济现实的残酷对比，修辞效果十分有力。
